reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and I'd be putting $360 on a big fragile fixture I can't see in person. I walked out of a showroom last weekend without buying, so I'm not about to take a leap on an unknown site.
objection: If the pendant arrives and it's not what the photos showed, I'm stuck paying return shipping on a huge box, and that could be $80 or more. Plus 10 to 12 business days, or 6 weeks if it's made to order, is a long wait with no way to see it first.
would_change_my_mind: Free return shipping or a prepaid return label, plus real customer photos and reviews from people who bought the same pendant.
